subject: Marketplace entry — SKU gating, regional capacity asks, and partner credits
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <eortiz@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace entry — SKU gating, regional capacity asks, and partner credits

Elena,

Quick summary of where we are for Greenfield Analytics (POC -> paid): they want a US-first listing (AWS) with an Azure parallel listing in Q1 2027. Two asks from our side to accelerate the co-sell commitment:

1) SKU gating: we want to list a single metered SKU for ML inference and a separate SKU for dedicated (reserved) capacity. Greenfield expects the metered SKU to be available in us-east-1 and us-west-2 on day one, and the dedicated SKU in us-east-1 with quota gating to 3 reserved instances for launch.

2) Partner credits: to hit their procurement threshold, they need $75k in marketplace credits spread over 12 months on the dedicated SKU to offset initial committed spend.

Attached is a proposed pricing matrix and a short quota request PDF. Can AWS confirm availability windows and whether the credits can be issued as an AWS Marketplace promotional offer tied to our seller account? Also please advise on lead time for listing and if there are any special co-sell paperwork items you need from us (we have a draft DocuSign ready).

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if easier.

–Sean
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_marketplace_quota_request.pdf (pdf)
From: Elena Ortiz <eortiz@aws-partner.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 12:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace entry — SKU gating, regional capacity asks, and partner credits

Sean — thanks for the clear ask.

Short answers:
- SKU availability: metered SKU listing in us-east-1 and us-west-2 is straightforward; Azure parallel listing will need separate partner intake but we can coordinate. For reserved capacity SKU, we can support quota gating but the marketplace listing must reflect quota constraints in the seller setup (we can help implement).
- Credits: we can route a promotional offer; typical approval for $75k is doable but I need approval from our incentives team. Please send the HubSpot deal ID and the DocuSign stub so I can attach to the request.
- Lead time: 4–6 weeks for an initial AWS listing if the seller account is already vetted; quota gating adds ~1 week. Co-sell paperwork (MOU) typically takes 3–5 business days once legal signs.

Two requests from me:
1) Can Redwood provide a simple SLAs table for the dedicated SKU (uptime, latency targets) for our listing page?
2) Please confirm the exact billing meter names you want on the metered SKU (we prefer short canonical names to avoid mapping issues).

If helpful, happy to set a 30-minute sync with incentives/legal next week.

—Elena
AWS Partner Manager

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace entry — SKU gating, regional capacity asks, and partner credits

Chiming in with internal constraints and options for Greenfield:

- Quota/capacity: Infra can provision the 3 reserved instances in us-east-1, but we need a 6-week lead time from order to guaranteed availability for the specific GPU family they want. We should flag a soft launch (metered SKU only) while the reserved capacity is being provisioned.
- Pricing: The attached matrix reflects two billing meters — inference.tokens.metered and inference.dedicated.instance-month — we should keep those canonical names for marketplace mapping.
- Credits: finance can support issuing a Redwood-backed credit (off invoice) that matches the AWS promotional offer if AWS cannot route the entire $75k. This helps procurement approvals.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Ask AWS for written confirmation of promotional offer path + expected approval timeline.
2) Offer Greenfield a 30-day metered-only pilot (via marketplace metered SKU) to shorten procurement times; reserved SKU comes later with quota gating.

I’ll update the pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx with the spool/lead times and reattach.

–Marissa
Sr. Product Ops

Elena — thanks. Quick replies inline:

> - SKU availability: metered SKU listing in us-east-1 and us-west-2 is straightforward;
We’ll proceed with a metered-only listing in both regions for launch. Reserved SKU will be us-east-1 only and gated to 3 reserved instances until we confirm provisioning.

> - Credits: we can route a promotional offer; typical approval for $75k is doable but I need approval from our incentives team.
If AWS can commit to initiating the promotional approval we’ll submit the HubSpot deal link and DocuSign (see links below). If incentives can only cover partial, Redwood finance will top up the remainder (we agreed internally this morning).

> - Lead time: 4–6 weeks for an initial AWS listing if the seller account is already vetted;
We have a vetted seller account. Please confirm a tentative launch window — if we aim for Nov 30 (6 weeks), Greenfield procurement can align.

Attached are the updated pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx and the redwood_marketplace_quota_request.pdf with the 6-week provisioning note.

Thanks — propose a 30-min sync Tue with AWS incentives/legal + our finance (Ben) and Karthik from product to finalize paperwork.

–Sean

Sean — good plan. I’ve kicked off the incentives request (ref INC-2026-9987) and attached the internal checklist. Early signal: incentives team is comfortable with $50k promotional credits pending legal sign-off; I’ve asked them to review the remaining $25k for exceptional approval.

Confirming tentative launch window: target Nov 30 for metered listing in us-east-1/us-west-2; reserve SKU gating to follow in early Jan 2027. I’ll book a 30-minute sync for Tue (invite to follow) so incentives/legal can be present.

—Elena
AWS Partner Manager
